```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Trump does not increase the Earned Income Tax Credit, demonstrating disdain for the needs of working families he claims to serve.",
"claim_types":["evaluation","factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Both bills reduce tax rates for the wealthy, sometimes in hidden ways.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The new child credit would be available for families with incomes as high as $1 million, instead of capping this credit at $110,000 as is currently the case.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many businesses (private equity firms, partnerships, limited liability corporations, S-corporations and sole proprietorships) currently pay little in the way of corporate taxes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Business income from these businesses is passed through to the owners, who currently pay individual income tax on it at a top rate of 39.6%.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"One of the central planks of the Trump/GOP tax proposals is to sharply reduce taxes on pass-through income.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The House bill reduces the rate on pass-through income to 25%.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Senate bill gives a 17.4% tax deduction for pass-through income.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"70% of income from pass-through entities goes to the top 1%.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These proposals would benefit millionaires.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump has over 500 pass-through entities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The proposed legislation would tax the repatriation of over $2 trillion in profits that US multinational corporations have stashed overseas at a rate of only 10-12%.",
"claim_types":["policy_position","factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"This rate is substantially less than the proposed reduced corporate tax rate of 20%.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
